questions.question: What is pollination?

options.text: The transfer of pollen grains from an anther to the stigma of a plant
The growth of pollen tube in the ovule

questions.solution:
Pollination

 
 
 
The transfer of pollen from a male part of a plant to a female part of a plant, enabling later fertilisation and the production of seeds, most often by an animal or by wind

 
 
 

 
 
Cross-pollination 

 
 
 
When pollen is delivered from the stamen of one flower to the stigma of a flower on another plant of the same species

 
 
 

 
 
Self-pollination

 
 
 
Pollen from one flower pollinates the same flower or other flowers of the same individual

questions.question: Name the reducing agent used in the reaction to join railway tracks?
questions.solution:
__
 
• Reducing agent (also called a reductant or reducer) is an element (such as calcium) or compound that loses (or "donates") an electron to another chemical species in a redox chemical reaction. Since the reducing agent is losing electrons, it is said to have been oxidized.
 
• **Fe₂O₃ and Aluminium as reducing agent**__ used in the reaction to join railway tracks and process is called as aluminothermy.

questions.question: Who gave the 'Raman's Effect'?
questions.solution:
• Raman’s Effect - The alteration of the frequency and the phase of light as it passes through a transparent medium. The Raman Effect is caused by small differences between the energy of photons absorbed by the molecules that make up the medium and the energy of photons re-emitted.
 
• C V Raman- Raman Effect (1928)
